## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] The base branch and branch name follow CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Behavior-changing code has meaningful regression tests, not only coverage filler.
- [ ] Shared-file changes were coordinated with their owners.
- [ ] No credentials, generated builds, unexplained ignores, or disabled quality gates.
- [ ] Evidence refers to the current candidate; new changes receive fresh review/testing.

A checkbox is a statement, not technical proof. GitHub rules and the protected release
review environment must be configured separately.
